name: Order Data 4
definition: Details of an order in financial instruments.

DirectElectronicAccess.name: Direct Electronic Access
DirectElectronicAccess.definition: Indicates whether the order was submitted to the trading venue using direct electronic access. ||USAGE: when absent, default value is false.

ClientIdentification.name: Client Identification
ClientIdentification.definition: Identification of the client of the member or participant of the trading venue.

InvestmentDecisionPerson.name: Investment Decision Person
InvestmentDecisionPerson.definition: Identification of the person or the algorithm within the member or participant of the trading venue who is responsible for the investment decision.

ExecutingPerson.name: Executing Person
ExecutingPerson.definition: Identification of the person or algorithm within the member or participant of the trading venue who is respon sible for the execution of the transaction resulting from the order.

NonExecutingBroker.name: Non Executing Broker
NonExecutingBroker.definition: Member or participant of the trading venue who routed the order on behalf of and in the name of another member or participant of the trading venue.

TradingCapacity.name: Trading Capacity
TradingCapacity.definition: Indicates the capacity from which the order submission was carried out.

LiquidityProvisionActivity.name: Liquidity Provision Activity
LiquidityProvisionActivity.definition: Indicates whether an order is submitted to a trading venue as part of a market making strategy.||USAGE: when absent, default value is false.

OrderClassification.name: Order Classification
OrderClassification.definition: Type of order in financial instruments.

OrderPrices.name: Order Prices
OrderPrices.definition: Prices related to an order in financial instruments. All prices should be expressed in the same unit and currency (when expresed in monetary value).

InstructionData.name: Instruction Data
InstructionData.definition: Date related to the order Instruction.

TransactionData.name: Transaction Data
TransactionData.definition: Transaction Data related to an order.
